ideas.title: Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigation into Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the recent case of a Twin Cities man who pleaded guilty to pocketing $300K or more in Medicaid fraud
questions: How widespread is Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
What measures can be taken to prevent Medicaid fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a large-scale fraud scheme and to highlight the need for increased scrutiny of Medicaid claims. Further investigation is needed to determine the extent of the fraud and to identify any other individuals or organizations involved.

ideas.title: Data Breaches in the Healthcare Industry
ideas.description: Investigation into data breaches in the healthcare industry, including the recent case of a data breach of patient records at Centers Lab NJ
questions: How common are data breaches in the healthcare industry?
What measures can be taken to prevent data breaches?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to highlight the need for increased security measures to protect patient records. Further investigation is needed to determine the extent of the breach and to identify any other individuals or organizations involved.
